verdict.rationale: Runway documents post-run spend tracking well: response metadata reports the realized credit cost, and the platform claims cost visibility per model, endpoint and team, with credits priced at $0.01. Pre-run cost visibility is weaker. The docs only describe published pricing rules (draft previews billed at the 480p rate) and comparing cost across models before production, not a per-generation quote shown before running. missing for 10: an explicit pre-run per-generation cost estimate in the app/UI, spend tracking for app (non-API) users, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: The response metadata reports the model used and the realized cost in credits.
Full visibility into cost per model, per endpoint, per team.
Credits can be purchased for $0.01 per credit in the developer portal for a project.
Score by quality, speed and cost before committing to production.
A preview (`draft: true` on text to video, image to video, or video to video) bills at the 480p rate.
